metadata.dataset_name: NASA SMAP & MSL Spacecraft Telemetry Anomaly Dataset
metadata.scientific_statement: SATSHIELD's anomaly-detection methodology was independently tuned and benchmarked on public NASA spacecraft telemetry using threshold optimization and temporal debouncing.

profile_evaluations.profile_name: Profile A: Baseline (Default IF, No Tuning)
profile_evaluations.description: Standard scikit-learn default IsolationForest decision threshold (score < 0).
Default threshold with 2-step temporal debounce to filter single-timestep noise.
Decision threshold tuned to -0.01 to eliminate weak baseline fluctuations.
Tuned threshold -0.03 combined with 2-step persistence for 57% FPR reduction.

profile_evaluations.profile_name: Profile E: High-Precision / Low False Alarm
profile_evaluations.description: Aggressive threshold -0.10 for critical telemetry alerting with 75% FPR reduction.
